summary: Frontend-only E2E test of KasirPro iteration 2 (barcode scanning + cash shift management) on the public preview URL with Playwright. All 12 requested scenarios were executed and PASS: (1) shift gate blocks POS until kas is opened (product card click intercepted by overlay) and opening 200000 unlocks POS with green 'Kas terbuka - modal Rp 200.000' badge; (2) keyboard/USB barcode via product-search + Enter adds BVG-001 Kopi Latte and FOD-001 Burger Sapi, clears the box and shows a success toast; (3) unknown code ZZZ-999 shows 'Barcode/SKU "ZZZ-999" tidak ditemukan' and adds nothing; (4) open-scanner opens scanner-modal with scanner-video and closes cleanly via modal-close; (5) checkout with an open shift creates INV-20260802-0013 with correct receipt; (6) /kas active shift stats match transactions exactly (modal 200.000, tunai 25.000/1 tx, non-tunai 0, seharusnya 225.000); (7) exact close: expected-cash 225.000, difference-preview Rp 0, summary modal correct, history row status tutup + Rp 0 in green; (8) mismatch close (opening 100.000 + 8.000 cash sale, actual 103.000) shows -Rp 5.000 in both summary and history row, rendered red (rgb ~ #dc2626); (9) after closing, /kasir gate blocks the POS again and the create_transaction RPC itself returns 400 P0001 'Kas belum dibuka. Buka kas terlebih dahulu sebelum bertransaksi.' with a matching error toast when the sale is forced from a stale tab; (10) kasir@toko.com sees only Kasir/Transaksi/Kas nav items, is redirected to /kasir from /produk and /pengguna, opened a shift, sold SNK-001 (INV-20260802-0015, cashier 'Kasir Satu') and closed its own shift with Rp 0 difference; (11) regressions OK: /transaksi lists 15 tx + receipt view, /laporan renders 3 recharts with 7/14/30-day ranges, /produk create-edit-delete works, /stok masuk+keluar adjustment works for admin and the adjust_stock RPC now rejects kasir with 'Hanya admin yang dapat menyesuaikan stok' (verified with a direct authenticated REST call), /pengaturan saves (name KasirPro Store, tax 0), /pengguna lists users with role select; (12) dropdown regression fixed - stock-product, stock-type, form-category and form-supplier all close after selecting and no longer block the fields below. All 4 iteration-1 defects are confirmed fixed. Data left clean: no shift open for admin or kasir, tax 0, store name KasirPro Store, roles unchanged, TEST_QA product/stock adjustments reverted or deleted.

ui_bugs.issue: Panel and StatCard did not forward data-testid, so the requested data-testid='active-shift' (and the shift stat cards) were absent from the DOM even though the panel rendered. FIXED BY TESTER: Panel/StatCard now accept and render data-testid, and /kas stat cards got stat-opening-cash, stat-sales-cash, stat-sales-noncash, stat-expected-cash (plus <testid>-value on the number).

integration_issues.flow: POS after the shift is closed elsewhere (stale client state)
integration_issues.issue: When the shift is closed in another tab/device, /kasir keeps showing the green 'Kas terbuka' badge and no shift-gate. Checkout is correctly rejected by the RPC with the right error toast, but the page never re-fetches the shift, so the cashier can retry indefinitely. Recommend calling muat() (or clearing shift state) in the create_transaction error branch when the message mentions 'Kas belum dibuka'.

BarcodeScanner's useEffect depends on onDetected/onClose, and KasirPage passes the inline (non-memoized) scanKode + arrow onClose. Every parent re-render (e.g. cart/search state change) recreates those props, so the effect tears down and re-starts decodeFromVideoDevice, i.e. the camera stream restarts repeatedly while the modal is open. Wrap scanKode in useCallback (or keep it in a ref) and keep only [open] in the effect deps.

issues: On an unknown barcode the search box keeps the invalid text (only the success path clears it), so the next scan from a hardware scanner appends to the previous code unless the cashier clears it manually - consider clearing the input on the not-found path too

Kasir sees every cashier's shift history (shifts_select policy is 'using (true)') while the heading '(semua kasir)' is only rendered for admin - either scope the query/policy to own shifts for kasir or show the label for everyone
Still uses native <input type=date> pickers instead of the design-system calendar (carried over from iteration 1, not part of this iteration's scope)

action_items: Refresh shift state on /kasir when create_transaction fails with 'Kas belum dibuka' so the shift-gate re-appears instead of a stale 'Kas terbuka' badge
Memoize scanKode/onClose (useCallback) so BarcodeScanner does not restart the camera on every KasirPage re-render
Optional: clear product-search after a not-found barcode; consider scoping shift history to the own cashier for the kasir role
Optional: handle the shifts query error in kasir/page.tsx muat() - a failed shifts select currently silently shows the blocking gate
critical_code_review_comments: components/ui/misc.tsx: Panel/StatCard swallowed data-testid, making key informational panels untestable (fixed by tester)
components/BarcodeScanner.tsx: effect deps include non-memoized callbacks -> camera stream restarts on each parent render
app/(app)/kasir/page.tsx: muat() ignores the shifts query error (sh.error), so an RLS/network failure is indistinguishable from 'no open shift'

app/(app)/kas/page.tsx: expected cash shown before closing is computed client-side; the RPC recomputes it server-side, so a sale landing between the two reads makes the previewed selisih differ from the stored one (acceptable, but worth a re-read before submitting)

success_rate.backend: not tested (frontend-only request); Supabase RPC guards verified indirectly: create_transaction and adjust_stock both return 400 with the expected Indonesian messages
success_rate.frontend: 12/12 requested scenarios passed; 2 minor integration issues + 1 testability defect (fixed) found

seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned: product TEST_QA Produk 2 / TST-002 (created, edited to 7.500, deleted); Burger Sapi stock +1 then -1 (net 17, notes TEST_QA adjust / TEST_QA revert); 4 shifts closed (admin 200.000 and 100.000, kasir 50.000 x2) and transactions INV-20260802-0013/0014/0015 remain in the DB (cannot be deleted from the UI). No shift left open, tax 0, store name KasirPro Store, roles unchanged.
test_credentials: admin@toko.com/admin123 and kasir@toko.com/kasir123 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md - both valid
context_for_next_testing_agent: App runs from a production build: after editing code run `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` and wait ~90s. Login page is /masuk with login-email/login-password/login-submit. Session is stored in cookies (NOT localStorage) - to make direct Supabase REST probes, read the sb-*-auth-token cookie chunks, join, strip the 'base64-' prefix, atob and take access_token. Custom Select: click [data-testid='<id>'] then [data-testid='<id>-option-<value>']; the re-open bug from iteration 1 is fixed. Transaksi rows are transaction-row-<id>/view-receipt-<id>; laporan has range-7/14/30 and chart-omzet/chart-metode/chart-top-produk. Kas page now exposes active-shift plus stat-opening-cash/stat-sales-cash/stat-sales-noncash/stat-expected-cash. RLS-blocked writes return HTTP 200 with an empty array, which the pages now detect. Untested: real camera decoding (Playwright fake device only) and a kasir attempting to close an admin's shift (no admin shift was open at the time).
rca_of_the_issue: Missing active-shift testid: ui/misc.tsx Panel/StatCard declared explicit prop types and dropped extra props, so data-testid passed from kas/page.tsx never reached the DOM; fixed by explicitly accepting and rendering it. Stale 'Kas terbuka' badge: kasir/page.tsx only loads shift state in muat() on mount/session change and does not re-load in the create_transaction error branch, so a shift closed elsewhere leaves the UI optimistic while the SECURITY DEFINER RPC correctly raises P0001.
